_description: Canonical conformance vectors for the activation predicates used by stake-weighted quorum, equivocation headers, and snapshot burial. The expected results pin the boundaries and fail-closed behavior specified by protocol/constants.js and protocol/protocol-activation.md. A snapshotBlock object with special 'nan' or 'undefined' represents the corresponding JavaScript value, which JSON cannot encode directly.

isStakeWeightedQuorumActive.name: mainnet is inactive one block below the flag day
mainnet activates at the flag day
a NaN snapshot block fails closed

isEquivHeaderActive.name: mainnet is inactive one block below the flag day
mainnet activates at the flag day
a NaN snapshot block fails closed

snapshotBurial.name: mainnet is active at its genesis boundary and clamps the buried height to zero
an active height inside the buffer clamps to zero
an active height above the buffer subtracts the canonical depth
null fails closed and is returned verbatim
an empty string fails closed and is returned verbatim
a boolean fails closed and is returned verbatim
undefined fails closed and is returned verbatim
a NaN snapshot block fails closed and is returned verbatim
an unknown network fails closed and returns the declared height
